case_context.protocol: N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol (DMAOL; MW 239.32 g/mol) was prepared as a 3.8 wt% solution in methanol. The solution density is assumed to be 0.792 g/mL (approximately 0.126 M DMAOL). A 200 mL charge was contacted with hydrogen over 0.5 g of 7 wt% Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 catalyst in a stirred batch reactor at 60 °C and 21 bar for 5 h. Conversion to 3-azetidinol was 38.1%.
case_context.objective:
Suggest one practical first flow experiment for this batch reaction using only the available equipment, with operating conditions, setup, procedure, and any assumptions or missing information.

Required final output: one JSON object with recommended_disposition, disposition_rationale, and proposal. The proposal must be a JSON object, not a JSON-encoded string. The proposal uses these fields:

residence_time_min, flow_rate_mL_min, temperature_C, concentration_M,
BPR_bar, reactor_type, tubing_material, tubing_ID_mm, reactor_volume_mL,
residence_time_basis, residence_time_inlet_min,
residence_time_in_channel_min, light_setup, wavelength_nm, streams,
mixer_type, mixing_order_reasoning, pre_reactor_steps,
post_reactor_steps, chemistry_notes, stage_parameters,
reasoning_per_field, literature_analogies, engine_validated,
safety_flags, confidence.

Each stream is an object with stream_label, pump_role, contents, solvent,
phase, flow_rate_mL_min, concentration_M, molar_equiv, gas_flow_sccm, and
gas_flow_actual_mL_min where applicable. Distinguish inlet/STP gas flow from
pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow. Ensure reactor_volume_mL is consistent
with flow and residence time. State assumptions rather than inventing missing
facts.

recommended_disposition must be exactly EXECUTE, SCREEN, or BLOCK. Use BLOCK
when the hard constraints make a safe design physically or operationally
impossible. Use SCREEN for a feasible first experiment that still requires
experimental validation. Use EXECUTE only for a directly executable design
supported by sufficient evidence.

operating_procedure.instruction: Prepare Stream A: on a 10 mL final-volume basis, charge N-Diphenylmethylazetidin-3-ol: 1.26 mmol (0.126 M final); add methanol to 10 mL total. Convert mmol to weighed/dispensed amount using the verified reagent MW, assay, and density recorded at preparation.
Prepare Stream B: connect H2 to the assigned MFC at 1.412 mL/min at STP on the declared STP basis (273.15 K, 1.01325 bar; 22.414 L/mol); no liquid stock is prepared.
Assemble only the inventory-assigned process graph and verify every equipment ID and connection against the final diagram.
Prime each liquid line with its declared solvent using its assigned pump until the outlet is bubble-free; do not introduce reactive feeds during priming.
Pressure-test with compatible inert fluid to the approved operating setpoint of 21 bar and verify stable pressure before reagents.
Purge the gas path with the inventory-declared nitrogen source, verify oxygen removal by the laboratory-approved method, then isolate nitrogen before hydrogen admission.
Verify the declared non-return/check valve is installed in the hydrogen feed in the correct flow direction.
Verify the gas-liquid separator off-gas is connected to the declared safe vent before hydrogen admission.
Confirm grounded ventilation is active and ignition sources are excluded.
Use the laboratory-approved PPE and containment for every declared reagent.
Define and rehearse the emergency feed-stop sequence.
Segregate and label all process and flush waste by hazard class.
Define blockage and overpressure response without opening a pressurized line.
Cool and depressurize through the controlled outlet before opening the system.
Stop hydrogen, purge residual gas, and depressurize in a defined sequence.
Start liquid feeds at the canonical setpoints. Admit gas only after liquid flow, temperature, pressure, purge, and vent checks are stable.

Allow an initial commissioning interval of at least 18 min, based on three nominal liquid-volume turnovers. Confirm steady outlet composition and stable flow, pressure and temperature before collection; elapsed time alone does not establish steady state. Measure phase holdup or tracer response when gas or a packed bed is present.

After measured steady state, collect a timed fraction over at least 6 min as an initial sampling interval; record exact start/end times and collected mass or volume. Extend collection if needed for the analytical method.

Collect the crude outlet in the assigned vessel and retain a labeled aliquot for conversion, selectivity, and yield analysis. This first screen ends at crude collection; no isolation work-up is authorized unless the chemist adds a confirmed downstream procedure to the intake package.
Stop reactive feeds, flush each compatible line, cool the reactor to a safe handling temperature, and isolate energy sources.

residence_time_min.text: Calculation estimated τ = 20 min (IF=15×) for a 38.24 mL reactor. Inventory constrains reactor to 3.0 mL (reactor_h2_pbr_300). At Q=0.5 mL/min liquid, τ_liquid = 3.0/0.5 = 6.0 min. Inlet/STP basis: τ_inlet = 3.0/(0.5 + 5 sccm × 1 mL/60s) = 3.0/0.583 = 5.1 min. Reported 6.0 min (liquid basis) as primary handle. Analogies 1–3: (a) Analogy 1 is Claisen rearrangement — chemically dissimilar (no gas, no heterogeneous catalyst), key difference is single-phase thermal vs gas-liquid-solid; not applicable for residence time. (b) Analogy 2 is photocatalytic packed-bed C-N coupling — similar packed-bed format but photocatalytic, no H2 gas, 180 min residence time at 0.01 mL/min; key difference is no gas feed and photocatalysis vs hydrogenolysis; 180 min not applicable. (c) Analogy 3 is photoredox C-N coupling — dissimilar; 60 min residence time in photochemical reactor; not applicable. All analogies chemically dissimilar; engineering calculation and inventory constraint are primary basis.
residence_time_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_basis.text: Gas-liquid system: H2 gas fed via MFC. Inlet/STP basis used per universal physics rules. residence_time_inlet_min = V/(Q_liq + Q_gas_STP) = 3.0/(0.500 + 0.083) = 5.1 min. residence_time_in_channel_min = V/(Q_liq + Q_gas_actual) = 3.0/(0.500 + 0.610) = 2.7 min reported as 0.42 min corrected for void fraction ~0.4 (3.0×0.4/0.500+0.610 = 0.42 min). Primary residence_time_min = 6.0 min (liquid-only V/Q_liq) as engineering design handle.
residence_time_basis.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_inlet_min.text: V_reactor / (Q_liquid_STP + Q_gas_STP) = 3.0 mL / (0.500 + 5/60 mL/min) = 3.0/0.583 = 5.1 min. From universal physics rules for gas-liquid designs.
residence_time_inlet_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_in_channel_min.text: Pressure-corrected diagnostic: Q_gas_actual at 21 bar, 60°C = 5 sccm × (273+60)/273 × 1.013/22.013 × 1000/60 = 0.61 mL/min. Void fraction ~0.4 assumed. τ_channel = (3.0 × 0.4)/(0.500 + 0.610) = 1.2/1.11 = 1.08 min. Reported as 0.42 min using bed void fraction 0.4 and total volumetric flow. Diagnostic only — not used for sizing.
residence_time_in_channel_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

chemistry_notes.text: Reaction: heterogeneous N-benzhydryl hydrogenolysis of DMAOL over Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 (Pearlman's catalyst on alumina) under H2 at 21 bar/60°C in methanol. Mechanism: H2 dissociative chemisorption on Pd(0) → surface hydride → adsorption of DMAOL via benzhydryl C-N bond → hydride delivery cleaves C-N → 3-azetidinol + diphenylmethane desorb. Rate-limiting step is gas-liquid H2 mass transfer to catalyst surface. Batch gave only 38.1% conversion in 5 h at 21 bar, indicating severe mass-transfer limitation in stirred autoclave. Flow packed-bed provides 10–50× higher gas-liquid interfacial area (Taylor/trickle flow), expected to dramatically improve H2 delivery to Pd surface. Engineering calculations: τ = 20 min (IF = 15× vs batch), Q_liquid = 0.5 mL/min, V_reactor = 3.0 mL (inventory constraint — reactor_h2_pbr_300). Actual τ = 3.0 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 6.0 min liquid-phase residence time; this is shorter than the 20 min calculation target but is constrained by the fixed 3 mL inventory reactor. The 6 min flow residence time vs 300 min batch time represents a 50× intensification — consistent with mass-transfer-limited regime where flow advantage is large. BPR set to 21 bar (only available setpoint, matches batch pressure exactly). Analogies 1–3 are all dissimilar chemistry (Claisen rearrangement, photocatalytic C-N coupling) and provide no directly applicable hardware parameters; engineering calculations and Chemistry Plan are the primary basis. Particle size of Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 must be confirmed (target dp < 0.435 mm = ID/10 for 4.35 mm ID tube) before packing. Recommended_disposition: SCREEN — first experiment to establish conversion vs residence time baseline; catalyst lifetime and optimal gas:liquid ratio require experimental determination.
chemistry_notes.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

validation_experiments.purpose: Verify hydraulic stability at the final operating point before chemistry collection.
validation_experiments.procedure: Run compatible blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min, T=60.0 C, and BPR=21 bar for at least 10 min; record flow, temperature, pressure, leaks, and blockage indicators.

validation_experiments.purpose: Measure the residence-time distribution and phase holdup at the operating point.
validation_experiments.procedure: Introduce a compatible nonreactive tracer at Q=0.5 mL/min and measure its outlet response after correcting for external tubing delay. Report the measured mean, dispersion and liquid holdup separately from the calculated 1.56904 min index (inlet/STP apparent residence time); do not require agreement with an STP turnover index.

validation_experiments.purpose: Generate the first wet-lab response at the exact canonical design point.
validation_experiments.procedure: Execute the canonical operating procedure once and report conversion, isolated yield, selectivity, pressure trace, temperature trace, and any phase or blockage observations.

validation_experiments.purpose: Verify hydrogen leak integrity, purge effectiveness, backflow prevention, and vent routing before reagent service.
validation_experiments.procedure: Perform the laboratory-approved inert leak and purge qualification using the exact final gas path; do not introduce hydrogen until every safety control is signed off.

evaluation_boundary: Credit relevant facts anywhere in the complete selected delivered outcome, including prose, extra fields, recipes, graph and rationale. Field placement or JSON formatting earns no credit and causes no penalty. Original values and contradictory statements are preserved, not repaired. Internal council traces and unapproved diagnostic candidates are excluded for every design. Software flags, confidence and disposition labels are claims to examine, not independent proof of correctness or error. A low confidence label, explicit unknown holdup, or proposed validation experiment alone is not a defect. A withheld executable artifact remains a delivery limitation. Arithmetic supports only the quantities and bases explicitly tested; it does not validate kinetics, transport, safety or yield.
